name: @ezxomp/gsd-graph
description: OMP extension: GSD knowledge graph + workflow execution engine. Knowledge-graph build/query/status/diff over .planning artifacts persisted to .gsd/graphs/, GRAPH.yaml run engine (create/list/status/next/complete), /gsd-graph command, and an optional session_start autoRebuild hook.

autoRebuild.label: Auto-rebuild knowledge graph
autoRebuild.description: Rebuild the GSD knowledge graph at session start when a graph already exists but is older than 24 hours (missing graphs are built explicitly). Disabled by default; rebuilds are opt-in.
